notes.title: Achievements Added to Sword of Jade
notes.notes: [p]Achievements have now been added to Sword of Jade and are now obtainable. [/p][p][/p][p]All of these achievements should unlock upon loading a save that has the conditions for the achievement met, and does not require replaying the entire game.[/p][p][/p][p]This is considered the "Base Set" for the game's main quest and Wave 1.[/p][p][/p][p]Wave 2 will add more in-depth achievements relating to the game's story and will also automatically unlock based off of data the game is already tracking in a future update.[/p][p][/p][p]Wave 3 will add achievements that require unlocking upon that update's release, and will be the final wave of achievements so that completionists can rest assured that your 100% will stay 100%![/p][p][/p][p]All achievements in Sword of Jade: Parallel Dreams will never require additional paid content to unlock, and will never require connection to an online server to unlock.[/p]
